text:
GTM members
Description
The GTM members command returns the number or list of pool members in
the specified state. If you do not specify a state, returns all pool
members.
Syntax
members
[
-list
]
<
pool
>
[
blue
|
green
|
yellow
|
red
|
gray
]
members <pool>
Returns the number of all pool members.
=====members -list <pool>=====
Returns a list of all pool members.
=====members <pool> [blue|green|yellow|red|gray]=====
Returns the number of pool members in the selected state.
=====members -list <pool> [blue|green|yellow|red|gray]=====
Returns a list of the pool members in the selected state.
